title: Laredo Blue Ribbon Committee Looks at Job Help for People With Disabilities
excerpt: Laredo's Blue Ribbon Committee discussed vocational rehabilitation services this week, spotlighting Workforce Solutions for South Texas and its four job placement specialists who help workers with disabilities find and keep jobs.
content:
Laredo's Blue Ribbon Committee is looking at ways to help more people with disabilities find jobs. Committee members discussed vocational rehabilitation services at a meeting this week, with a focus on the help available through Workforce Solutions for South Texas.

Workforce Solutions for South Texas helps eligible workers with disabilities find and keep jobs, offering job training and support for workers and employers, with support tailored to each worker's individual needs.

Four job placement specialists serve the community. Regular job-placement support generally lasts up to 90 days, though some workers may receive help for longer.

Cecilia Gutierrez, the committee's secretary, said the goal is independence: not every person with a disability needs someone sitting right next to them at work. The idea, she said, is to build independence and make the employer responsible.

The committee's discussion put a spotlight on a service many residents may not know exists — free, individualized help finding work and staying employed.

Source: Laredo Blue Ribbon Committee, Nov. 20, 2026.
